slices.focus: Caleb launches monthly paperwork clinics for the corridor after proving doubled workshop-to-application conversion rates to Sharon
slices.summary: Using sign-in sheets, call logs, and a whiteboard tally, Caleb shows Sharon that the hands-on workshop format nearly doubled conversion rates. This earns him approval to start monthly paperwork clinics at a church fellowship hall, with one-on-one application help, document troubleshooting, and Miguel's engineer office hours.

Define scope of Miguel's office hours to keep it sustainable
Capture common technical questions into a plain-language handout
